entities.summary: Vladimir Mikhailovich Jurowski born 4 April 1972) is a Russian conductor resident in Germany. He is the son of conductor Michail Jurowski, and grandson of Soviet film music composer Vladimir Michailovich Jurowski. Vladimir Jurowski was a composers & musicians from Moscow (b. 1972-04-04, Moscow). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
